# ScribeCat 0.25.17

### PDF viewer
- Use an icon-only split-view action in the PDF toolbar.
- Show multi-page previews at their native page proportions instead of stretching them to large cards.
- Browse long PDFs six pages at a time in the multi-page overview.
- Reduce a minimized inline PDF to its document title and one restore control.
- Keep fullscreen available in the mobile PDF toolbar.

### Editor
- Wrap complete toolbar groups cleanly when an editor pane becomes narrow, including split view.
- Hide the Journal and Tasks folders, including notes below them, from the toolbar's Insert link picker.
- Keep table edge + controls from appearing over other interactive controls or stealing nearby clicks.

### Server and Docker
- Release metadata and Compose defaults are updated to 0.25.17.
